title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional MONTH-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-05-28 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-05-25 close), the last reset that can bind the June quarter-end test
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, read direct by this proposer rather than inherited, and DISPUTED BETWEEN TWO OWNER DOCUMENTS -- which is why it is filed estimate and stated plainly. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-08): every Russell US Style row in section 4.8.6 reads frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month" (footnote 3), trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". AGAINST THAT, FTSE Russell's "Frequently Asked Questions -- Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams, re-fetched the same session) still says verbatim "The review is conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)". The 2026-12-31 sibling dated the change from archived guide editions -- v5.3 (August 2026) already reads Monthly, v5.2 (June 2026) reads the quarterly wording and carries no frequency column -- and this session reproduced the v5.4 row-level reading independently. If the FAQ governs, this event does not exist. THE 2027 DATE IS RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: last business day of May 2027 is Friday 2027-05-28 (Memorial Day falls on Monday 2027-05-31 -- nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, corroborated by this repo's src/domain/market-calendar.ts), and T-3 back from it is Tuesday 2027-05-25. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, and because the owner's own two documents disagree about whether the check happens at all. Discovered during the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 initial research (2026-09-08). THE 2026-12-31 SIBLING DECLINED THE 2027 MONTH-END CLASS AS A WHOLE and its reasoning is on the record -- "no owner document published this session names a 2027 date, and extrapolating a standing rule twelve months out is calendar noise, not foresight." That reasoning is accepted and this proposal is the ONE deliberate exception to it, filed with the difference stated rather than quietly overriding a sibling's call. The difference: this instance is not calendar filler, it is THE DISCRIMINATING INPUT to an event this calendar already tracks. The proposer found June to be the only quarter whose style capping review takes effect AFTER the quarter-end test's own price date (review effective open 2027-06-28, concurrently with reconstitution, against a test struck on the 2027-06-25 close), so the June test reads an index the June review has not yet recapped and the cohort's drift runs from whatever reset was last actually in force. Under the guide's monthly reading THIS check is that reset, 21 sessions before the June test; under the FAQ's quarterly reading it does not exist and the binding reset is the March quarter-end check, 74 sessions before. Measured on the proposer's own five-year bar set (1,253 usable sessions, 2021-09-09 to 2026-09-04), those two readings price the June test at 223/1,179 = 18.91% and 512/1,179 = 43.43% -- a 2.3x spread that turns entirely on whether this event happens. The other 2027 month-ends remain declined on the sibling's grounds: none of them changes a number on any event this calendar carries. HOW IT WOULD BE CONFIRMED OR KILLED, so the next lane does not have to re-derive it: an FTSE Russell index notice recording a Russell US Style recap effective on any month-end that is not also a quarter-end (2026-10-30 and 2026-11-30 are the nearest, already proposed by the 2026-12-31 sibling) confirms the monthly cadence from the tape rather than from a table; a guide version past v5.4 or an FAQ revision restoring quarterly wording for the section 4.8.6 Russell US Style rows kills this entry and it should be withdrawn rather than researched. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on the family's measured grounds: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-08), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Proposed as an estimate on a disputed rule; nothing here licenses an entry.
